lemmas.name: maxSubarraySum_ok
lemmas.statement: ∀ (numbers : List Int) (h : maxSubarraySum_precond numbers), maxSubarraySum_postcond numbers (let subArraySums := List.range (numbers.length + 1) |>.flatMap (fun start => List.range (numbers.length - start + 1) |>.map (fun len => numbers.drop start |>.take len |>.sum)); subArraySums.foldl max (subArraySums.headD 0)) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro numbers h
  unfold maxSubarraySum_postcond
  exact Refine.maxlist_int _ (List.ne_nil_of_mem (a := 0) (List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨0, List.mem_range.mpr (by omega), List.mem_map.mpr ⟨0, List.mem_range.mpr (by omega), by simp⟩⟩))
